resources.string: 1. Turn on \"USB debugging\" in Developer options.\n2. Plug the tablet into the PC.\n3. Press \"Connect\" in TabDisplay on the PC.
Press \"Wi-Fi (QR code)\" on the PC, then scan the code shown on the PC.
Scan the QR code shown on the PC
This is not a TabDisplay QR code.
Could not connect to the PC.\nCheck that the PC and tablet are on the same Wi-Fi, and that TabDisplay is open on the PC.
The PC refused the connection. Scan the QR code again.
This tablet cannot play the video. Try a lower resolution in Settings.
The PC is set to \"PC only\". Nothing is shown on the tablet.
The virtual display is not installed on the PC. Press \"Install virtual display\" in TabDisplay on the PC.
Connect automatically when a PC I used before is found on Wi-Fi
Tap: click / Long press: right click / Drag: scroll\nTwo-finger tap: right click / Pinch: zoom / Pen: pen input with pressure\n⌨ button: keyboard

- With two or more tablets, connecting or disconnecting one stops the picture on all tablets for a few seconds.
- When quality changes automatically, or when you rotate the tablet, the picture stops very briefly.
- All communication is encrypted. The first Wi-Fi connection needs the QR code on the PC (it is used to verify the PC).
- Windows of programs running as administrator on the PC cannot be operated from the tablet.
- Pen pressure and tilt need Windows 10 (1809) or later on the PC.
- The PC's sound plays here with a short delay.
- For USB, turn on "USB debugging". For Wi-Fi, put the PC and tablet on the same network.
- The screen stays on while connected, which uses more battery. Charging while you use it is recommended.
Checked buttons are shown on the right edge (open with ☰). ↑ moves a button up.
Power saving: dim the screen after 5 minutes without touching
Touchpad mode: slide to move the pointer, tap to click, two-finger tap to right click, two-finger slide to scroll, double tap and slide to drag
Could not confirm this PC. Scan the QR code on the PC again.
Pen tablet mode: the picture is not shown. This tablet\'s surface matches the PC\'s main screen.
The window to show was not found on the PC.

Buttons at the bottom right: ☰ shortcuts / 🎮 gamepad / ◧ right, middle and scroll buttons on the left edge (hold Right or Middle and tap the screen) / ✎ pen tablet mode (no picture) / 🖱 touchpad mode / ⌨ keyboard\nGamepad buttons are sent as keys: arrows, A=X, B=Z, X=S, Y=A, L=Q, R=W, START=Enter, SELECT=right Shift
Show this device\'s screen on another tablet

No PC needed. On the other tablet, open TabDisplay, press \"Scan QR code\" and scan the code shown here. Both devices must be on the same Wi-Fi.\nTo operate this device from the other tablet, turn on the TabDisplay accessibility service (Android 7 or later). Taps, long presses, scrolling and simple text input work.
Also send this device\'s sound (Android 10 or later)
Allow operation from the other tablet (open accessibility settings)
Operation from the other tablet: on (open accessibility settings)
Show this device\'s screen on another tablet
Used only while this device\'s screen is shown on another tablet with TabDisplay, to turn taps and scrolling on that tablet into taps and scrolling on this device.
